raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

With more than one decode rank (CFG parallel, TP or SP), the LTX VAE installs spatially sharded convs that exchange halo rows with the neighbouring rank. Those convs expect each rank to hold its own height split. But:
- `_decode` checked tiling before the sharded path;
- `tiled_decode`, `_temporal_tiled_decode` and `decode_chunk` called the decoder on whole tensors while the sharded convs were installed.

So each rank blended its neighbour's copy of the same tile into its own edge rows.

Decoding a real LTX-2 latent (768x512x121) on 2xH200, with 2 decode ranks compared against 1:
- main: rank 0's max error is 135/149 levels, and 36.9%/41.7% of the pixels in the bottom 32 rows are off by more than 2 levels. Rank 1 mirrors this at the top.
- this PR: both ranks are identical, at 58.2–58.5 dB against the 1-rank untiled decode (bf16 noise).

This affects the LTX-2, LTX-2.3 and LTX-2.5 conv VAE on multiple GPUs with default flags, and SANA-WM's streaming `decode_chunk`. The Wan and Hunyuan VAEs are not affected.

## Modifications

`ltx_2_vae.py`: every decoder call now either runs on this rank's height split or bypasses the sharded convs (new `_decode_spatial`).
- With tiling on, the height split replaces tiling when each rank's rows fit in one tile. A rank therefore still decodes at most one tile's area at once.
- Otherwise every rank tiles the whole clip under `disable_spatial_parallel_decode()`, exactly as on one rank. Large frames keep per-rank tiling because at 1920x1088 the untiled sharded path costs 28–38 GB more per rank.
- Framewise decoding applies the same rule to each temporal tile, and the streaming `decode_chunk` bypasses the sharded convs.

`pipeline_configs/base.py`: drop the "vae_sp requires vae_tiling" check. `vae_sp` gates nothing at runtime, and the height split never uses tiles, so `--vae-tiling false` now works on its own.

New test `test/unit/test_ltx_vae_parallel_decode.py`: two gloo ranks on CPU decode a tiny LTX-2 VAE with sharded convs and compare against one rank on 5 paths:
- tiled, below the auto threshold;
- tiled with `spatial_shard`;
- height split;
- framewise;
- `decode_chunk`.

Follow-up, not fixed here: the diffusers 2D VAE has the same ordering bug, but only with tiling plus the opt-in `--vae-config.parallel-decode-mode spatial_shard`.

## Accuracy Tests

- Real LTX-2 VAE on 2xH200: see Motivation. Both ranks now decode identically, at 58.2–58.5 dB against one rank.
- `test_ltx_vae_parallel_decode.py`: main fails on all 5 paths, with max abs error 1.00–1.24 across the two ranks. This PR matches one rank exactly (0.0).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

LTX-2 on 2xH200. On main, the halo traffic on whole tiles made the tiled decode slower than on one rank.

| | main | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| VAE only, 768x512 | 0.342 s | 0.135 s (1-rank tiled: 0.265 s) |
| pipeline decode stage, 768x512 | 0.665 s | 0.418 s |
| decode, 1920x1088 | 3.63 s, peak 82.4 GB | 3.07 s, peak 79.9 GB |

At 768x512, e2e is −4.7% / −2.8% over two interleaved rounds, and memory is 1.7 GB lower per rank.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Two decode ranks must reproduce the single-rank LTX-2 VAE decode.
+
+The ranks run over gloo on CPU, so this needs no GPU.
+"""
+
+from datetime import timedelta
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+import torch.multiprocessing as mp
+
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.configs.models.vaes.ltx_video import (
+    LTXVideoVAEArchConfig,
+    LTXVideoVAEConfig,
+)
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.distributed import parallel_state
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.parallel_conv import SpatialParallelConv3d
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.models.vaes import common
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.models.vaes.ltx_2_vae import (
+    AutoencoderKLCausalLTX2Video,
+)
+
+WORLD_SIZE = 2
+
+
+class _DecodeGroup:
+    def __init__(self, rank: int):
+        self.rank_in_group = rank
+        self.world_size = WORLD_SIZE
+        self.ranks = list(range(WORLD_SIZE))
+        self.device_group = dist.group.WORLD
+
+    def all_gather(self, x: torch.Tensor, dim: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+        gathered = [torch.empty_like(x) for _ in range(self.world_size)]
+        dist.all_gather(gathered, x, group=self.device_group)
+        return torch.cat(gathered, dim=dim)
+
+
+def _tiny_vae(**config) -> AutoencoderKLCausalLTX2Video:
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    arch = LTXVideoVAEArchConfig(
+        latent_channels=4,
+        spatial_compression_ratio=2,
+        temporal_compression_ratio=2,
+        block_out_channels=[8],
+        down_block_types=["LTX2VideoDownBlock3D"],
+        spatio_temporal_scaling=[True],
+        layers_per_block=[1, 1],
+        downsample_type=["spatiotemporal"],
+        patch_size=1,
+        decoder_block_out_channels=[8],
+        decoder_spatio_temporal_scaling=[True],
+        decoder_layers_per_block=[1, 1],
+        decoder_inject_noise=[False, False],
+        upsample_residual=[True],
+        upsample_factor=[2],
+    )
+    vae = AutoencoderKLCausalLTX2Video(LTXVideoVAEConfig(arch_config=arch, **config))
+    # 4-row latent tiles on a 3-row stride: an 8x8 latent spans 3x3 tiles
+    vae.enable_tiling(
+        tile_sample_min_height=8,
+        tile_sample_min_width=8,
+        tile_sample_min_num_frames=8,
+        tile_sample_stride_height=6,
+        tile_sample_stride_width=6,
+        tile_sample_stride_num_frames=4,
+    )
+    return vae.eval()
+
+
+@torch.no_grad()
+def _check_decodes(rank: int) -> None:
+    reference = _tiny_vae(use_parallel_decode=False)
+    auto = _tiny_vae()
+    sharded = _tiny_vae(parallel_decode_mode="spatial_shard")
+    assert any(isinstance(m, SpatialParallelConv3d) for m in sharded.decoder.modules())
+    torch.manual_seed(1)
+    z = torch.randn(1, 4, 7, 8, 8)
+    errors = {}
+
+    def compare(name, actual, expected):
+        assert actual.shape == expected.shape, (name, actual.shape, expected.shape)
+        errors[name] = max(
+            errors.get(name, 0.0), (actual - expected).abs().max().item()
+        )
+
+    # below the auto threshold every rank decodes the whole clip, tiled as on one rank
+    compare("tiled", auto.decode(z).sample, reference.decode(z).sample)
+    # 4 rows x 8 per rank exceed a 4x4 tile, so every rank still tiles the whole clip
+    compare("tiled_shard", sharded.decode(z).sample, reference.decode(z).sample)
+    # they fit a 6x6 tile, so the height split replaces tiling
+    sharded.enable_tiling(
+        tile_sample_min_height=12,
+        tile_sample_min_width=12,
+        tile_sample_stride_height=10,
+        tile_sample_stride_width=10,
+    )
+    reference.use_tiling = False
+    compare("height_split", sharded.decode(z).sample, reference.decode(z).sample)
+    reference.use_framewise_decoding = sharded.use_framewise_decoding = True
+    compare("framewise", sharded.decode(z).sample, reference.decode(z).sample)
+    reference_cache, cache = {}, {}
+    for chunk in z.split(3, dim=2):
+        compare(
+            "chunk",
+            sharded.decode_chunk(chunk, cache),
+            reference.decode_chunk(chunk, reference_cache),
+        )
+    mismatched = {name: err for name, err in errors.items() if err > 1e-5}
+    assert not mismatched, f"rank {rank}: max abs error vs one rank {mismatched}"
+
+
+def _decode_on_two_ranks(rank: int, rendezvous: str) -> None:
+    dist.init_process_group(
+        "gloo",
+        init_method=rendezvous,
+        rank=rank,
+        world_size=WORLD_SIZE,
+        timeout=timedelta(seconds=60),
+    )
+    parallel_state._VAE_DECODE = _DecodeGroup(rank)
+    try:
+        with patch.object(common, "model_parallel_is_initialized", return_value=True):
+            _check_decodes(rank)
+    finally:
+        parallel_state._VAE_DECODE = None
+        dist.destroy_process_group()
+
+
+def test_two_decode_ranks_match_one_rank(tmp_path):
+    rendezvous = (tmp_path / "rendezvous").as_uri()
+    mp.spawn(_decode_on_two_ranks, args=(rendezvous,), nprocs=WORLD_SIZE)
